verdict.rationale: Bruno's own CLI runs whole API collections in one command, and its docs mention automated data-driven runs. That is batch execution across many requests or data rows, a form of bulk operation. There is no evidence of bulk editing, updating, deleting or otherwise manipulating many items at once, and the depth of the batch-run capability is only thinly described. Missing for 10: bulk edit/update/delete of requests or collections, documented batch-selection semantics, detailed data-driven iteration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: With Bruno CLI, you can run your API collections with ease using simple command line commands.
Write assertions and test suites, and automate runs with data-driven testing.
Run your collections in Docker, GitHub Actions, and other pipelines.
